literal: Even if you conceal, transgressing the limit and refusing to cooperate, your kohl-dyed eyes, to speak, that which they intend, one thing, there is.
translation: Even if you try to hide your feelings, going beyond all limits of self-control and refusing to cooperate, there is something that your kohl-dyed eyes are trying to say.
modern: நீ மறைக்க முயன்றாலும், எல்லை கடந்து உனக்கு அடங்காமல், உன்னுடைய மை தீட்டிய கண்கள் சொல்ல விரும்பும் செய்தி ஒன்று இருக்கிறது.
explanation: In this couplet, the speaker observes that the lady is trying hard to conceal her inner feelings of love or longing. However, her beautiful, kohl-dyed eyes ('உண்கண்') refuse to cooperate with her attempt at secrecy. They have transgressed the limits of her self-control ('கை இகந்து ஒல்லா') and are visibly eager to reveal the truth. The speaker gently points out that there is indeed a message ('உரைக்கல் உறுவது ஒன்று உண்டு') written clearly in her gaze.
